title: Gravity
desc: On an outer space mission, engineer Ryan Stone and astronaut Matt Kowalski are hit by high-speed space debris. As the situation gets dire, Stone rises to the occasion as a survivor.

title: Jumanji: Welcome to the Jungle
desc: Four teens are transported into a magical jungle game, becoming adult avatars and must navigate challenges to return home safely.

title: Evil Dead
desc: Five friends decide to spend a weekend in a remote cabin located deep in the forest. When they accidentally summon a dormant demon, they strive to survive its evil ploys.

title: Men in Black II
desc: Agent J is after a shapeshifting alien seeking a powerful but little-known object. To save the world, he must reunite with his former partner, Agent K.

title: Mindhunters
desc: A group of FBI trainees are taken to a remote island for simulation training. However, once there, they realise that they are being hunted by a serial killer, who might be someone amidst them.

title: Searching
desc: Single father David Kim learns that his daughter, Margot, has gone missing. Desperate to do something, he checks Margot's laptop and finds clues and hidden truths.
